result.title: Class-Conditional Conformal Prediction for Signal Temporal Logic Inference with Many Classes
result.summary: Signal Temporal Logic (STL) inference provides interpretable formulas for time series classification. For multiclass classification, however, accurate predictions do not necessarily ensure that the inferred formulas are satisfied consistently with the true class. We introduce the positive satisfaction rate and codeword satisfaction rate to quantify satisfaction of required formulas and consistency with the complete class codeword, respectively. We develop a two-stage procedure that first learns discriminative formulas using a margin-based objective and then refines predicate thresholds toward a small positive robustness target while fixing the formula structure and temporal intervals. Satisfaction and ranking penalties discourage violations of required formulas and loss of class separation. The decoding loss is used as a nonconformity score and calibrated separately for each class, providing finite-sample class-conditional coverage under intra-class exchangeability. Experiments on naval, synthetic, and robot manipulation trajectories demonstrate discrepancies between classification accuracy and formula satisfaction. The results further reveal a data-dependent tradeoff between robustness tightness and satisfaction, while class-conditional calibration mitigates undercoverage that can be hidden by pooled calibration.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究多类时间序列分类中的信号时序逻辑（STL）推断：指出分类准确不等于公式被满足，提出正满意度与码字满意度指标，并用两阶段流程（边际目标学习公式、固定结构后精修谓词阈值）配合按类校准的共形预测，给出有限样本类条件覆盖。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「结构化时序公式的满意度度量＋类条件共形校准」可能为 LVR 提供两点线索：如何诊断内部推理状态是否真正满足任务必要约束，以及如何用校准方式支撑停止与判定；迁移可行性需核查。
